item.title: Prime time puzzle: AI chip booms and the housing freeze
item.description:
The homebuying season had a rocky start....
Hey, hey. A new generation is discovering the wisdom of Groucho Marx. Namely, that a fake mustache is an unbeatable disguise. Faced with online safety rules meant to protect them from harmful content, kids in the UK revealed in a recent survey that they’re able to defeat age-verification software by drawing on facial hair. Maybe we don’t need to be scared of the machines taking over after all.

item.title: Follow the Money Brew: SpaceX shadow markets and billionaire dinosaur fossils
item.description:
Where people are putting their cash...
Good morning, and Happy Mother’s Day. If you need a last-minute gift for Mom, simply share the knowledge you’ll acquire from reading today’s special edition of the Brew, which is all about the strange places people park their cash (including Pokémon cards and ETFs for aliens, naturally). You’ll also get the inside scoop on the retail investing revolution and how family offices have taken over as the financial consiglieres for the ultrarich.
